<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/organizations/{organizationId}/users"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Lists your organization's credentials, newest first.

Results are paged. Pass `limit` and follow the `next` link in the `Link` header to get the next
page. Without `limit`, a page holds up to 2,000 credentials; this default may be lowered.

Each set of credentials in the response includes its password in clear text and a connection
string. Don't log the response or pass it to an untrusted client.


This list is paged: pass `limit` and follow the `Link` header. See [Pagination](./pagination.mdx).
